plan.name: 我的户型 · 可拆效果测试版
plan.summary: 三室两厅三卫＋储藏间 · 尺寸待校准

notes.zh: 拆改效果测试：原待定墙在模型中设为可拆，可逐段拆除和恢复。此设定仅用于效果演示，不代表实际墙体可拆；平面尺寸、门窗及墙厚仍待实测校准。
notes.en: Demolition preview: previously unverified wall segments are editable for visual testing. This is a simulation setting, not a structural assessment. Plan dimensions, openings and wall thickness still require measurement.
